About CouponHunter

We help everyday shoppers save money on the things they already buy — using AI to surface the best deals, faster.

Our Mission

Saving money shouldn't require hunting through dozens of sites or clipping paper coupons. CouponHunter aggregates the best deals from trusted affiliate partners worldwide — so you get more value with less effort.

How It Works

1

Set your location

We use it to surface deals near you or from global merchants you shop with.

2

Browse or search

Filter by category or search for a specific store or product type.

3

Tap to use

Click any coupon to go directly to the deal, or print it for in-store use.

4

Save your favorites

Heart any deal to save it — access your saved coupons anytime.

Features

Smart Coupon Search

Our AI-powered search finds the best deals for your location in real time — no manual browsing needed.

Location-Based Deals

We surface coupons relevant to where you are, whether you're in Manila, New York, or anywhere in between.

Save Your Favorites

Bookmark deals you love and access them anytime — even offline. Your saved coupons are always with you.

QR & Barcode Scanner

Spot a coupon in the wild? Scan it directly in the app and we'll save it to your collection instantly.

Verified Deals Only

Every coupon we surface comes from verified affiliate partners and trusted coupon networks.

Always Up to Date

Deals are refreshed regularly. Expired coupons are flagged automatically so you never waste a trip.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is CouponHunter free to use?

Yes, completely free. We earn a small commission from affiliate partners when you use a deal — at no extra cost to you.

How do the coupons work?

Click "Use Now" on any digital coupon to go directly to the merchant's site with the deal applied. For printable coupons, click "Print Now" and bring the printed copy to the store.

Are the deals available worldwide?

We support a growing list of global merchants. Some deals may be region-specific — set your location for the most relevant results.

How do I report an expired or broken deal?

Email us at support@couponhunter.coupons and we'll investigate and remove it promptly.

Can I use CouponHunter on mobile?

Absolutely. The site is fully optimized for mobile, and the QR scanner works with your phone camera.

Affiliate Disclosure

CouponHunter participates in affiliate programs including Involve Asia, Rakuten, and CJ Affiliate. When you click a deal and make a purchase, we may earn a small commission — at no additional cost to you. This helps us keep the site free and the deals fresh.
